historical_goal: Homogeneous point-in-time reconstruction of 3M/6M/12M central-bank market pricing across the project historical window without look-ahead or benchmark substitution.

authorized_current_source.method: Direct official settlement prices transformed as 100 minus compounded CORRA

blocker.summary: A homogeneous CRA history cannot cover the full historical window because CAD short-rate futures transitioned from BAX/CDOR to CRA/CORRA in 2024.

official_evidence.event: BAX contracts expiring after June 2024 were converted into equivalent Three-Month CORRA Futures (CRA) contracts after market close.
official_evidence.context: The conversion was part of the transition away from CDOR ahead of cessation on 2024-06-28.

blocker.implication: Using BAX/CDOR before the transition and CRA/CORRA afterwards would introduce a benchmark and instrument-family regime change. Under the current Temporal PIT contract this cannot be silently treated as one homogeneous historical series.

decision.next_safe_option: Only revisit if a separately versioned methodology explicitly models the BAX/CDOR to CRA/CORRA regime transition and validates comparability; do not weaken the current homogeneous PIT contract.

discovery_context.note: The archive discovery was started before the structural benchmark-transition evidence was confirmed. Its completion is not required to establish the full-window homogeneous-series blocker.
